companies.name: Rosco Fine Foods
companies.distributes: Chocolate, pralines and chocolate boxes, confectionery and seasonal gift ranges from European and UK brands, close to 40 brands and over 1,000 items
companies.channels_supplied: Department stores, supermarkets, specialty retail and fresh food retailers across Australia, with interstate distribution partners in each state
companies.fit_rationale: A family-owned importer that buys European and UK confectionery brands such as Ritter Sport, Anthon Berg and Holdsworth on an exclusive basis and builds them in Australian retail, the closest match to Diablo's model of a brand builder. It already sells chocolate, pralines and Christmas gift ranges to supermarkets and department stores, so Diablo's no-added-sugar chocolate and gift boxes would sit naturally in its portfolio. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.
what_they_do_well: Trading continuously since 1980 as an Australian family-owned importer.
Holds exclusive Australian distribution for European brands including Ritter Sport, Anthon Berg and Holdsworth.

companies.name: Horse Torque & Lollies
companies.distributes: Bulk and packaged sweets, gummies and jelly sweets, British and American chocolate and sweets, and soft drinks
companies.channels_supplied: Retailers, events and workplaces Australia-wide, plus its own store in Noble Park
companies.fit_rationale: An importer and wholesaler of sweets and chocolate that welcomes bulk and business orders from retailers and already runs a dedicated British chocolate and sweets range, so a UK-made sugar-free line fits its offer. It ships Australia-wide, which gives Diablo's sweets and chocolate a route into independent shops. Storage: ships from its Melbourne warehouse, as stated on its website.
what_they_do_well: Runs a dedicated British chocolate and sweets range alongside American imports for Melbourne retailers.

companies.name: The Market Grocer
companies.distributes: Confectionery and chocolate (Fyna, Hugos, Mars, Maltesers, Twix, Hi Chew, Nerds, Swizzels, Big Lolly), kids confectionery, biscuits and cookies (Sunday Cookies), snacks, health and protein lines, nuts and pantry goods
companies.channels_supplied: Independent specialty grocers and major supermarkets across Australia
companies.sf_brands_carried: Health and protein section; Orgran gluten-free snacks. No sugar-free confectionery brand named
companies.fit_rationale: A national grocery wholesaler that already lists a deep range of branded confectionery, chocolate, biscuits and snacks from other companies for independent grocers and supermarkets. Diablo's chocolate, sweets and biscuits would sit beside its health and protein section as a sugar-free option. Storage: own warehouse at Homebush, Sydney, with warehousing and distribution to retailers.
what_they_do_well: Supplies independent specialty grocers and major supermarkets across Australia from its own Homebush warehouse.

companies.name: Punjab Imports
companies.distributes: Indian packaged foods with its own sections for biscuits and bakery, confectionery, sweets, snacks, chips and rusks
companies.channels_supplied: Supermarkets, independent grocers, convenience stores and food resellers across Victoria through trade accounts, plus its own Indian grocery stores
companies.fit_rationale: A Melbourne trade wholesaler of Indian packaged food whose website has its own biscuits, confectionery, sweets and snacks sections and supplies supermarkets, grocers and convenience stores. Diablo's halal-certified biscuits and sweets suit the shops it serves. Storage: Melbourne warehouse for bulk pallet supply, scheduled deliveries and stock replenishment.
what_they_do_well: Runs a Melbourne warehouse with scheduled deliveries across Victoria and stores in Hoppers Crossing, Craigieburn, Clyde, Melton, Shepparton and Wollert.

companies.name: Global Quality Foods (GQF)
companies.distributes: Snacks, chips, confectionery and candy, drinks, grocery, ice cream and frozen lines, packaging and cleaning products
companies.channels_supplied: School canteens, sporting clubs, cafes, wholesalers and food service businesses across Sydney
companies.fit_rationale: A family-run Sydney wholesaler whose canteen and club customers resell packaged snacks and confectionery as they are, like the Swiss snack counter model. Tier 3 because it reaches canteens and clubs rather than many shops. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

companies.name: Metropolitan Snack Foods
companies.distributes: Snack foods, confectionery, beverages, iced confectionery, frozen foods, groceries and packaging
companies.channels_supplied: School canteens and clubs in metro and regional NSW
companies.fit_rationale: A Sydney canteen wholesaler delivering snack foods and confectionery to schools and clubs that sell them on as packs, seven days a week. Tier 3 because its customers are canteens and clubs and its website names no brands. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.
what_they_do_well: Delivers to school and club canteens across metro and regional NSW seven days a week.

companies.name: BL Vending (Melbourne Free Vending Machines)
companies.distributes: Branded chips, chocolates, drinks and protein products for vending, sold wholesale and stocked in its own machines
companies.channels_supplied: Workplace vending machines it operates and wholesale vending supplies for other buyers
companies.sf_brands_carried: Healthy options and protein products; brands not named on its website
companies.fit_rationale: A snack vending operator with more than 16 years in vending that also sells chocolates, chips and drinks wholesale. Diablo's bars and chocolate fit a workplace machine as a sugar-free option. Tier 3 because it reaches workplaces rather than shops. Storage: moved to a much larger warehouse, location not named on its website.
what_they_do_well: More than 16 years of experience running workplace vending in Melbourne.

companies.name: Gnibl
companies.distributes: Healthy snacks, protein bars, chips and protein shakes for wholesale delivery and vending
companies.channels_supplied: School canteens, workplaces and vending machine sites such as gyms, universities, hospitals and warehouses
companies.sf_brands_carried: Dietitian-curated healthy snack range; brands not named on its website
companies.fit_rationale: A Sydney healthy snack wholesaler and vending operator whose dietitian-curated range targets health-conscious buyers, a close match for Diablo's sugar-free bars and biscuits. Tier 3 because it serves canteens, workplaces and vending sites and its website names no brands. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.
